commit_subject: fix(self): apply EMA confidence and persist owner-correction staleness

1_ema_confidence.what: OCTOPUS_SELFKNOW_HEURISTIC_V2 no longer forces confidence=None ahead of measured EMA. If _accuracy_ema() returns a number, it lands on the persisted snapshot as confidence_basis=accuracy-ema-forward-only. No history -> honest None. No invented 0.4.

2_owner_correction_staleness.what: run() copies owner_correction_age_days and owner_correction_stale from snapshot() onto the persisted record (changed + cached paths). File/state only. No Telegram memory-gate.

3_always_true_probes.what: Deleted or True from _probe_named_owner and _probe_trace_independent. Trace status now follows ALERTS_MD existence. Named-owner is Partial if مالك is found else Missing. No new always-true probes.

skipped.4_self_claims_emit: Existing self_accuracy._emit_calibration_pair already writes selfknow.<field> claims to cortex/self-claims.jsonl (schema self-claim.v1) when CORTEX_SELF_MONITOR is on and prior confidence exists. EMA landing unblocks _prior_confidence() on the next cycle. New emit/schema would be a redesign; skipped.
skipped.self_insight_weekly_journal: Existing hook is loops/closeout.self_insight_shadow() with journal=false; registry S-A02 says weekly later. Full self_insight.run() is a ~46s self_scan. Wiring unclear without new flags; skipped.
skipped.flag_comment_vs_value_probe: No small existing helper that compares a rem/comment to a live @set without pulling in flag_drift.probe_all(). Stopped lying instead of adding a new probe that could poison calibration.
